title: SQS Execution Channel Descriptor
description: How a governed host actually reaches a provider_family's models. Distinct from provider_family (the model vendor): a qualification is keyed on the model itself so it never needs re-testing just because the access channel changes.

execution_channel.description: Open identifier for the access channel, e.g. 'codex_workspace'. Not an enum of two -- new channels to the same or a different provider_family will appear.

provider_family.description: The model vendor this channel reaches, e.g. 'openai'. Multiple execution channels may share the same provider_family.

provisioning_model.description: How the channel is provisioned, e.g. 'workspace' (org-managed seats, uniform entitlement across staff) or 'api_key' (per-integration credential). Open string, not an enum of two.

reasoning_tier_taxonomy.description: Identifier for which reasoning-tier taxonomy this channel's models report against (matches a provider_family's tier-mapping convention).

availability_check.description: Reserved for the service-availability check (SQS integration plan Task 6a). Optional until that task defines its shape.
